title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Polymerase Chain Reaction for Mycobacterium Tuberculosis Using EBUS-TBNA Samples
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the diagnostic efficacy of nested and realtime polymerase chain reaction for Mycobacterium tuberculosis using EBUS-TBNA samples in patients with isolated intrathoracic lymphadenopathy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with isolated intrathoracic lymphadenopathy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Suspicion of primary lung cancer on CT or PET scan
* Suspicion of pulmonary tuberculosis on CT or PET scan
* Suspicion of sarcoidosis of lung parenchyma on CT or PET scan
